description: This Java source file defines the ContentBrowserActivity class for an Android app, demonstrating UI features such as immersive content display, system UI flags, action bar tabs, and share actions. It includes an inner class Content that manages immersive view behavior.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Inner class extending ScrollView, providing immersive content display with system UI visibility control, including toggling navigation and full-screen modes based on user interaction and system UI changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, creates tabs, and configures action bar with options and share intent.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu, configures search view, and sets up share action provider.

methods.name: onSort
methods.description: Placeholder for menu item selection handling.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for showing/hiding tabs and toggle UI flags.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles search query text change events.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles search query submission, displays a toast.
